summary: No experiment commits were found in the timing window for milestone 2026.05.250 — this is the twenty-fifth consecutive empty-timing-window retro. Both RTX 3090 GPUs were idle at retro time (0% utilization, 5 MB allocated each); with zero compute-bound experiments completed, this is expected and not a bug.
bottlenecks_identified: Timing-script look-back window is not anchored to the conductor-state.json activation timestamp, causing all post-activation experiment commits to fall outside the measurement window — root cause of the 25-milestone zero-data streak.

scikit-learn dependency absent in the execution environment: exp2596 (tier0s retrain), exp2597 (tier0u fix), and exp2600 (safety corpus verifier) all emitted blocked_sklearn in milestone .249 and remain unresolved entering .250.
IPFS mirror path was not communicated from exp2553 to the IPFS-pin task in subsequent milestones, leaving Rule-3 secondary-channel distribution incomplete.
No experiment was activated same-session as planning, breaking the continuity that would allow at least one task to land within the retro look-back window.
improvements_suggested: Fix timing-script look-back to use conductor-state.json 'activation_time' field instead of a fixed-offset git-log window; this single change resolves the 25-milestone measurement gap.
Install scikit-learn as a milestone-open precondition check: `python -c 'import sklearn'` before activating any task that imports it, with blocked_sklearn_missing verdict if absent.

Wire a conductor pre-activation guard that halts milestone activation when zero experiments are completed and the retro would be trivially empty; prompt operator to activate at least one experiment before closing.
Communicate IPFS CID artifact path from exp2553 into the IPFS-pin task's precondition block so the mirror task knows which package to pin.
Use DualGPURunner for any future milestone containing 2+ concurrent GGUF-inference tasks; both GPUs are available and idle — there is no hardware constraint preventing parallel model loading.
top_3_highest_leverage_actions: Fix timing-script look-back to conductor-state.json activation timestamp — resolves the entire 25-milestone empty-data streak in a single commit, enabling all future retros to report real numbers.

Install scikit-learn as a mandatory milestone precondition — unblocks exp2596/2597/2600 (tier0s retrain, tier0u fix, safety corpus) which have been blocked for 2+ milestones and are gating real-corpus AUROC improvement.

Activate at least one sklearn-unblocked experiment same-session as milestone planning — breaks the zero-execution pattern without requiring any infrastructure change, providing immediate evidence of forward progress.
meta_reflection: Twenty-five consecutive empty-timing-window retros represent a systemic measurement failure, not a research stall — experiments are completing (changelog shows dozens of results in .245–.249) but the retro tooling cannot see them. The process is generating results; the accounting layer is broken. The highest-leverage action is fixing the accounting, not changing the research program.
